mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as totalActiveUsers, SUM(CASE WHEN total_spent > 1000 OR order_count > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as corePaidUsers, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_spent) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) as avgCustomerValue, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2), 0) as repurchaseRate FROM t_user_portrait
SELECT province as name, COUNT(user_id) as value FROM t_user_portrait WHERE province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY province ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT favorite_category as name, COUNT(user_id) as value FROM t_user_portrait WHERE favorite_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY favorite_category

SELECT CASE WHEN total_spent >= 5000 THEN '高购买力 (王者)' WHEN total_spent >= 1000 AND total_spent < 5000 THEN '中购买力 (黄金)' ELSE '普通用户 (青铜)' END as name, COUNT(user_id) as value FROM t_user_portrait GROUP BY CASE WHEN total_spent >= 5000 THEN '高购买力 (王者)' WHEN total_spent >= 1000 AND total_spent < 5000 THEN '中购买力 (黄金)' ELSE '普通用户 (青铜)' END
